description: Predict ImageNet zero-shot learning curves across OpenCLIP architecture families, epochs, and cumulative training samples.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are imagenet-zeroshot-val-top1, imagenet-zeroshot-val-top5.
